title: Caturo phalā
text: 2. Cattāro me bhikkhave dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti || katame cattāro || || [page 411] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 411 3. Sappurisasaṃsevo saddhammasavanaṃ yonisomanasikāro dhammānudhammapaṭipatti || || 4. Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattantī ti || ||
